name: Colorado
distinct: Sets the program**'**s highest structural floor: mandatory annual third-party cGMP audit for hemp safe-harbor registrants — this alone determines the base Canna-Safe surveillance cadence for Colorado-licensed clients regardless of risk tier.

name: California
distinct: Governs product-design child-safety rules, tincture alcohol-content/dual-licensure triggers (DCC §17302 family), and packaging requirements — several items are flagged in the register as pending full regulatory-text verification.

name: Washington
distinct: The most prescriptive state in the framework: explicit homogenization mandate, dual-agency (WSDA + LCB) recipe approval, TCS-food and frozen-dessert exclusions, and numeric water-activity thresholds.

name: Missouri
distinct: Categorically excludes cannabis-infused frozen desserts and acidified foods — a hard binary exclusion rather than a risk-managed permission, unique among the five target states.

name: Arkansas
distinct: Shares dosage-cap and child-appeal packaging restrictions with the other four states; several Arkansas-specific citations are drawn from the AR NORML regulatory summary pending primary-source verification.
